Normalized Heritage (RFI v1.0). Ported to Roll for Initiation: 7-damage-type canon, Soma Break, Tier-based scaling, reroll-lowest. Replaces the D&D5E heritage draft dated 2026-04-19 00:10.

“Some stone was born yelling.”

Menhirkin (Igneous). You are new rock. The Shattering was your birthday. The land that decided to stand up and walk chose you because it wanted a mouth that remembered being molten. You run hot, you cool slow, and you are, structurally, still furious about something.

Heritage Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Menhirkin).
  • Size. Medium. Speed: normal.
  • Heat Memory. You resist energy damage (halved, floor). Extreme heat does not hinder you.
  • Molten Bearing. When you take energy damage, you can note it and hold it. 1/Soma Break, add energy damage equal to your Tier to a single weapon strike, unarmed strike, or grapple — the heat comes back out. The strike inherits damageFlavor: fire for narration.
  • Signature. You gain Magma Memory at character creation.

Engine note. Where this heritage grants a damage-type resistance, it is applied by the fourththing defense engine via flags.fourththing.grants. Narrative immunities (sleep, forced movement, cold iron) are descriptive only until the Phase 3 condition-and-flavor engine ships.

advancement.hint: Gain the Menhirkin (Igneous) signature feat: Magma Memory.
